Hackathon Game is a canvas game: guide the glowing core orb to absorb elemental orbs and chain reactions. Use W and S to move up and down, minus and plus to change speed, and reach 10,000 points to win.

Controls

w/s/↑/↓/swipe up/swipe down: Move along y-axis

-/a/: Decrease Max Speed

=/+/d : Increase Max Speed

Rules and a guide to the game: Rules

  • Use W/S to move vertically
  • Use +/- or A/D to adjust speed
  • Combine elements for reaction bonuses
  • Reach 10,000 points to win
